name: Director Siobhán Kerrigan

intro.text: Five thousand years this tomb has waited for the sunrise. And now it has a sponsor.
Step aside. The light comes in at dawn and the Wardstone will catch it. And whatever comes with it.

win: No. No, no. The light's in the passage. What is that shape on the stones?
after: I think I'll be handing in my lanyard.
